text:
Type: rectangular wood-framed wall mirror
Use: reflecting light, checking an outfit; hallway, bedroom, living room, bathroom
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: solid wood frame with a stained finish, mirror glass
Colors: dark black-brown wood, silver glass
Shape: tall rectangle with a wide profiled moulded frame, rounded stepped edges, hangs upright or sideways, solid medium visual weight
Feel: classic, sturdy, warm, timeless
Goes with: white walls, dark wood furniture, cream textiles, brass accents; traditional, farmhouse or classic rooms
